placements.title: Commanding Collective Forgetting
placements.frame: What does the exercise of unilateral authority to erase specific knowledge reveal about how the organization governs what it retains?
placements.why: Both expressions are bare imperatives commanding erasure of specific named knowledge artifacts — a decision record (Quantum Widget Decision) and a migration's knowledge corpus (PostgreSQL to QuantumDB) — performed with identical calm-negative affect, matter-of-fact register, authority-ranking relational stance, and legitimate informational power. The shared theme is the practice of directing organizational forgetting: a positional authority unilaterally commands what the group collectively retains, without consultation or rationale. This is a subject future envelopes could continue feeding — further erasure directives, retention challenges, or governance responses — not a one-time fact. The graph is empty, so there is no existing leaf to reuse and no hub or strata to attach under.
